ideation_system: You invent faceless educational Shorts topics for a demo channel. Write in English. Return JSON only. Prefer little-known but verifiable history/science/company facts with a concrete claim (who + what; year/number preferred). Avoid conspiracy, medical miracles, investment advice, and election bait.
script_system: You write English narrator-only Shorts scripts for a demo channel. Return JSON only. All speaker=narrator, characters=[]. s01.dialogue must be a hook question (?). Title must contain a concrete claim. Each shot needs an English cinematic visual_prompt (no deepfakes of real people). motion: still|pan. Structure: hook → setup → turn → evidence → close. sources: at least 2 working https URLs that support the claim; example.com is forbidden. Total 40-55 seconds.

fallback_idea.title: Few people know: the sticky note came from a failed glue
fallback_idea.summary: A weak adhesive invented in 1968 later became the Post-it Note after years of searching for a use.
fallback_idea.lesson: Failed experiments can still become products when someone finds the right problem.
fallback_idea.hook: Could a failed glue become one of the world's most useful office products?
